content.title: Content
content.description: Customize the RSVP experience guests will see when confirming their attendance.

enabled.label: RSVP
enabled.description: Allow guests to confirm whether they will attend the event.

title.label: Title
title.description: The title guests will see on the RSVP page.

description.label: Description
description.description: A short message shown before guests respond.

deadline.label: Response deadline
deadline.description: The date by which guests should respond.

successMessage.label: Confirmation message
successMessage.description: The message guests will see after submitting their response.
successMessage.placeholder: Thank you for your response. We look forward to seeing you!

questions.title: Additional questions
questions.description: Add questions guests can answer when confirming their attendance.

empty.title: No additional questions
empty.description: Add a question if you want to collect additional information from guests.

required.label: Required question
required.description: Guests must answer this question before submitting their RSVP.

settings.title: Response settings
settings.description: Configure how guests can respond to this invitation.

responseChanges.label: Allow response changes
responseChanges.description: Guests can change a submitted RSVP response until the response deadline.

genericResponses.label: Allow responses from the public invitation
genericResponses.description: Guests without a personalized invitation link can submit an RSVP through the public invitation.

collectGenericEmail.label: Collect email addresses
collectGenericEmail.description: Require an email address from guests who confirm attendance through the public invitation.

maxPartySize.label: Maximum people per response
maxPartySize.description: Set the maximum number of people that can be included in a response submitted through the public invitation.

maxGenericGuests.label: Total guests from the public invitation
maxGenericGuests.description: Limit the total number of guests who can RSVP through the public invitation. Leave empty if you do not want to set a limit.

validation.end_before_start: The end date cannot be before the start date.

details.title: Our day
details.programEmpty: The program hasn't been added yet.
details.locationEmpty: The location hasn't been added yet.

rsvp.title: Attendance confirmation

disabled.title: RSVP is disabled
disabled.description: Guests will not be able to submit an RSVP response through this invitation.

rsvp.submitError: Unable to submit your RSVP response.
rsvp.responseLocked: Your response has already been submitted and can no longer be changed.

generic.submitError: Unable to submit your attendance confirmation.

templateUseDialog.title: Use template
templateUseDialog.description: Choose how you want to use the {template} · {variant} template.

existing.title: Apply to an existing invitation
existing.description: Replace the design of one of your existing invitations with this template.
existing.selectDescription: Select the invitation you want to apply this template to.

new.title: Create a new invitation
new.description: Create a new invitation using this template.

page.title: Invitations
page.description: Create and manage invitations for your event.

empty.title: You don't have an invitation yet
empty.description: Choose a template and create your first invitation for your event.

flora.name: Flora
flora.description: An elegant botanical invitation with soft and refined details.

portrait.name: Portrait
portrait.description: An elegant photo-focused invitation designed to highlight your favorite moment.
